walk.environment:
Build: the read-only worktree /tmp/claude-0/rewalk2/tree at 9eb10528, never edited. Every server ran from it through /tmp/claude-0/rewalk2/out/P/launch.py, a copy of the earlier row-P launcher pointed at rewalk2/tree. It drops HTTP(S)_PROXY, ALL_PROXY, NO_PROXY, OO_DB_PASSPHRASE and OO_DB_PLAINTEXT, sets PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1, chdirs to the tree and execs `.venv/bin/python -c "from src.api.main import main; main()"`. Port 9621 throughout, one server at a time. Every server was stopped by PID: 18781 (folder A, which exited through the app's own power icon), 19453 (folder A relaunched) and 19645 (folder B). No pkill or killall.

Data folders: I copied none. Both were built fresh, so there was no stale briefing_cache.json.
- Folder A (/tmp/claude-0/rewalk2/out/P/dataA) reproduces the row's fresh-install environment. It was started with OO_AUTOSEED=0 and made ENCRYPTED through the real first-launch screens: language, legal, 'Where should your corpus live?' (GET /api/system/data-location 200), then passphrase walk-pass-2026. lock-state went from 'fresh' to 'unlocked-encrypted'. After the power-icon quit and relaunch it read 'locked' and was unlocked through #pw / #btn-unlock.
- Folder B (/tmp/claude-0/rewalk2/out/P/dataB) was seeded at 20:32 UTC on 2026-09-27 (machine TZ UTC, so the expected 'changes today' is 4). I ran scripts/ui_clickthrough_seed.py (453 articles), then a copy of docs/audit/living-sources-clickthrough-2026-09-25/seed.py (PYTHONPATH=tree). Both ran with OO_DB_PASSPHRASE=walk-pass-2026 and OO_DB_PLAINTEXT unset. The first 16 bytes of open_omniscience.db and wiki.db are ciphertext, not 'SQLite format 3'. B was booted with neither variable set; lock-state read 'locked', and I unlocked through #pw / #btn-unlock. At unlock the app seeded 6195 catalog sources on its own ('Seeded 6195 catalog sources at startup').

Airplane: I did not use OO_NO_SCHEDULER. Each of the three boots logged 'Booted in airplane mode (offline)', and /api/system/network answered online:false at every check, including after the last run. No POST /api/system/network appears in any server log. 'Go online' was never pressed. Every consent popup was opened, read, screenshotted and closed with 'Stay offline'.

Harness setup, disclosed as the previous walker did: between the ar, zh and fr passes W was put back to 'running' with a loopback PUT /api/scheduler/config {wiki_lane_state:'running'} and a reload. Offline there is no UI path from stopped back to running without consent, and the kill switch stays engaged.

Browser: Playwright Chromium at /opt/pw-browsers/chromium, headless, args --disable-background-networking --disable-component-update --no-proxy-server --no-sandbox --disable-dev-shm-usage, proxy variables unset. A request listener logged 0 off-host requests. Main passes ran at 1440x950 (en, plus live #lang-switch switches to ar, zh and fr). 375x800 passes ran in en, fr and ar, with extra Home checks in de and ru.

Scripts, JSON and 155 screenshots are in /tmp/claude-0/rewalk2/out/P/ and shots/: walk_a.py, restart_a.py, walk_b.py, probe_p5.py, probe_items.py, probe_narrow.py, probe_live.py, probe_pal2.py; a_p1_p2_p3_p4_p5.json, restart_a_{quit,start}.json, b_en.json, b_locales_ar_zh_fr.json, b_narrow_narrowlangs.json, probe_*.json.

walk.summary:
Row P passes. Build 9eb10528, both data folders encrypted and locked at boot, airplane mode throughout. 'Go online' was never pressed and every consent popup was cancelled.

Steps P1-P4 and P6-P11 pass, and the 375 px pass (N375) passes. P5 is not-measurable-here after consent; its offline parts pass: the consent gate, the power-icon restart into the lock screen and airplane mode, and default-on held offline. P11 and N375 failed last time and now pass.

All six row-P items are fixed:
- P-1 / P-3: the Arabic wizard host line now isolates each host, so '*.wikipedia.org' is drawn intact at 1440 and 375 px.
- P-2 / P-4: the French Home strip at 375 px no longer scrolls sideways (0 px after a live switch and after a reload; de and ru also 0).
- P-5: an idle, offline Home strip shows no 'server busy' note at cache age 129-141 s (verified_current:true).
- P-6: the palette's two Wikipedia rows now read 'Local copy' and 'Tracked changes'. The first opens the reader; the second opens Living sources with that page's tracked changes loaded.

There were no page errors, no HTTP errors ≥ 400 from the app, and no off-host requests. The only console errors were the expected ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED after the power-icon shutdown; the one 503 in the logs was my own curl to /api/system/network while folder A was still fresh and locked. Two minor incidentals are recorded and do not affect the row: the Tracked changes panel is below the fold after the palette jump, and the French transport hover uses a plain space before the colon.
